summary: Psygnosis and Studio Liverpool's anti-gravity racing series; prioritize PC or modern Omega Collection routes where they improve fidelity, while preserving console-exclusive entries such as Wipeout 64.

entries.title: Wipeout

emulation.emulator: DOSBox / PC compatibility tooling; DuckStation fallback
emulation.notes: Use DuckStation for the PlayStation version and Mednafen/SSF-style Saturn routes only for comparison.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: PC display flexibility or high-resolution PS1 emulation

primary.why: The first Wipeout shipped on PlayStation, PC, and Saturn; the PC route gives the highest practical display flexibility for the original game while preserving the same core release.
primary.how_to_play: Use the original DOS/Windows PC release through a compatible modern setup such as DOSBox/PC compatibility tooling; use DuckStation for the PlayStation version if you prefer the original console presentation.

all_releases.fidelity: Original PlayStation release and European launch title.
all_releases.reason: skip: use for original console feel; PC route is the main high-fidelity pick.

all_releases.fidelity: Original PC release documented for DOS and Windows.
all_releases.reason: primary: best practical fidelity route for the original multi-platform release.

all_releases.fidelity: Saturn port with alternate music because Sony held rights to some PlayStation soundtrack material.
all_releases.reason: skip: interesting alternate soundtrack route, but not the highest-fidelity main playthrough.

all_releases.fidelity: Downloadable release of the PlayStation version.
all_releases.reason: skip: convenient official legacy access, but not higher fidelity than the PC route.

all_releases.fidelity: Mobile PlayStation Pocket release for Xperia Play.
all_releases.reason: skip: preservation curiosity, not the main fidelity route.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Saturn has alternate music due licensing differences, while PC is the main high-fidelity route and PlayStation remains the original console reference.

entries.remaster_caveats: No full modern remaster of the first Wipeout is documented.

entries.title: Wipeout 2097
entries.definitive_edition: Windows PC release, with PlayStation as presentation reference

emulation.notes: Use DuckStation for original PlayStation presentation comparison.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Higher-resolution PC rendering with lighting caveat

primary.why: The PC version supports higher resolutions and 3D acceleration, making it the highest-fidelity route, though it has documented lighting tradeoffs versus PlayStation.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows PC release with modern compatibility wrappers; use DuckStation for the original PlayStation version if you want the original lighting/presentation balance.

all_releases.fidelity: Original PlayStation release, titled Wipeout XL in North America and Japan.
all_releases.reason: skip: original reference version, but PC has higher-resolution/3D-accelerated output.

all_releases.fidelity: PC version supports higher resolutions and 3D acceleration but has inferior lighting versus PlayStation.
all_releases.reason: primary: highest graphical-fidelity route with a noted lighting caveat.

all_releases.fidelity: Sega Saturn port with analog control through the 3D Control Pad.
all_releases.reason: skip: lower priority than PC/PlayStation routes and no unique campaign content documented.

all_releases.fidelity: Later Amiga/WarpOS port.
all_releases.reason: skip: historical port, not the main fidelity route.

all_releases.platform: Classic Mac OS / Mac OS X
all_releases.fidelity: Mac port released years after the original.
all_releases.reason: skip: historical port, not the main fidelity route.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: PC has higher resolution/3D acceleration but inferior lighting compared with PlayStation, so visual fidelity and original presentation do not perfectly align.

entries.remaster_caveats: No modern remaster of Wipeout 2097/XL is documented.

emulation.notes: Use high-resolution output; original hardware preserves controller feel.

primary.why: Wipeout 64 is the Nintendo 64-exclusive entry with its own weapons, challenge mode, and four-player split-screen support.
primary.how_to_play: Play the N64 release through a modern N64 emulator with high-resolution output, or on original Nintendo 64 hardware.

all_releases.fidelity: Original N64-exclusive entry.
all_releases.reason: primary: only documented platform route and a distinct console-exclusive game.

emulation.notes: Use high internal resolution; confirm PAL compatibility for Special Edition.

primary.why: The PAL Special Edition adds tracks/content to the PlayStation release, while DuckStation provides the best practical image quality.
primary.how_to_play: Play Wipeout 3: Special Edition through DuckStation with high internal resolution and PAL timing support; use the standard release only for regional comparison.

all_releases.fidelity: Original PlayStation release with 16:9 widescreen and high-resolution mode.
all_releases.reason: skip: Special Edition is more complete.

all_releases.fidelity: European Special Edition with additional tracks and content.
all_releases.reason: primary: most complete version, best played with high-resolution PS1 emulation.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Special Edition is both the most complete release and emulates well.

primary.why: Fusion is the only original Wipeout made for PlayStation 2 and has no modern port documented; PCSX2 gives the best practical fidelity.
primary.how_to_play: Play the PS2 release through PCSX2 at high internal resolution, or on original PS2 hardware.

all_releases.fidelity: Original PS2 release.
all_releases.reason: primary: only documented platform route.

entries.title: Wipeout Pure
entries.definitive_edition: PSP original with preserved downloadable content where available

primary.why: Pure is a PSP-only entry; PPSSPP offers the highest practical fidelity for the original handheld release.
primary.how_to_play: Play the PSP release through PPSSPP at high internal resolution, preserving any available downloadable content where possible.

all_releases.fidelity: Original PSP entry.
all_releases.reason: primary: only documented platform route.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Some Pure material later appears through Wipeout HD/Omega routes, but Pure itself remains a PSP title with its own release context.

entries.remaster_caveats: Wipeout HD contains content derived from Pure and Pulse, but is not a one-to-one Pure port.

entries.title: Wipeout Pulse

emulation.notes: Use the European PS2 release for included DLC; PPSSPP is for PSP comparison.

primary.why: The European PS2 port includes enhanced graphics, two-player split-screen, and all downloadable content, making it the most complete version.
primary.how_to_play: Play the European PS2 port through PCSX2 at high internal resolution; use the PSP version only for handheld-original comparison.

all_releases.fidelity: Original PSP release with online/community features that are now shut down and downloadable content that was region-limited.
all_releases.reason: skip: PS2 port includes all DLC and higher-fidelity local presentation.

all_releases.fidelity: Europe-only PS2 port with enhanced graphics, split-screen, and all DLC included.
all_releases.reason: primary: most complete release and best emulation fidelity.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The PS2 port is both more complete and better suited to high-resolution emulation.

entries.remaster_caveats: Wipeout HD/Omega use content from Pure and Pulse but are separate entries rather than direct Pulse ports.

entries.title: Wipeout HD

emulation.emulator: None for PS4; RPCS3 archival fallback
emulation.notes: PS4/PS5 backward compatibility route is preferred.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: PS4 Pro 4K/HDR-capable remaster with optional PS VR support

primary.why: Omega Collection remasters Wipeout HD with the Fury expansion alongside Wipeout 2048, improving visual fidelity on PS4/PS4 Pro and adding later PS VR support.
primary.how_to_play: Play Wipeout Omega Collection on PS4 or PS5 backward compatibility; install the free PS VR update if using VR.

all_releases.fidelity: Original PS3 downloadable release.
all_releases.reason: skip: superseded for fidelity by Omega Collection.

all_releases.fidelity: Wipeout HD Fury expansion/release.
all_releases.reason: skip: Fury content is included in Omega Collection.

all_releases.fidelity: Omega Collection remaster of HD and Fury.
all_releases.reason: primary: highest-fidelity official route for HD/Fury content.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Omega Collection includes HD and Fury content in the highest-fidelity official package.

entries.remaster_caveats: Omega Collection is a remaster package, not a new HD campaign.

entries.title: Wipeout 2048

emulation.emulator: None for PS4; Vita3K archival fallback
emulation.notes: PS4/PS5 backward compatibility route is preferred.

primary.why: Omega Collection remasters Wipeout 2048 for PS4/PS4 Pro, making it the highest-fidelity official way to play the Vita entry's content.
primary.how_to_play: Play Wipeout Omega Collection on PS4 or PS5 backward compatibility; use Vita only for original handheld play.

all_releases.fidelity: Original Vita launch-era release.
all_releases.reason: skip: Omega Collection remaster is the fidelity pick.

all_releases.fidelity: Omega Collection remaster of Wipeout 2048.
all_releases.reason: primary: highest-fidelity official route.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Omega Collection is the recommended high-fidelity route for 2048 content.

entries.remaster_caveats: Use Vita only if original handheld controls/context matter.

entries.title: Wipeout Omega Collection
entries.definitive_edition: Omega Collection with PS VR update

emulation.notes: Use PS4 hardware or PS5 backward compatibility.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: PS4 Pro 4K/HDR-capable remaster with optional PS VR support

primary.version: Omega Collection with PS VR update
primary.why: Omega Collection brings together Wipeout HD, HD Fury, and Wipeout 2048 content in an enhanced PS4 package, with a free PS VR update released later.
primary.how_to_play: Play on PS4 or PS5 backward compatibility; update to the latest version for PS VR support if desired.

all_releases.fidelity: Enhanced PS4 compilation of HD, Fury, and 2048 with later PS VR support.
all_releases.reason: primary: only documented platform route and the definitive official modern Wipeout package.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Single-platform compilation and current best official package for included modern-era content.

entries.remaster_caveats: Compilation covers HD/Fury/2048, not the full PS1/N64/PS2 catalog.

entries.title: Wipeout Merge

emulation.notes: Use original mobile platforms if available.

primary.why: Wipeout Merge is the mobile-exclusive spin-off with management/merge mechanics rather than traditional racing.
primary.how_to_play: Play the iOS/Android release if still available in your region; otherwise treat it as an archival mobile spin-off.

all_releases.fidelity: Mobile spin-off release.
all_releases.reason: primary: one of the two documented mobile platforms.

all_releases.fidelity: Mobile spin-off release.
all_releases.reason: skip: same mobile game; choose the available device/store route.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: As a live/mobile title, availability can vary by store and region; treat unavailable installs as archival.

entries.remaster_caveats: Mobile spin-off with different mechanics, not a traditional Wipeout racing sequel.
